description:
You are a production coordinator organizing a messy Blender scene for a studio pipeline.

The current scene has 14 objects all dumped into a single default 'Collection':
- 7 Meshes: BaseCube, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Torus, Suzanne, GroundPlane
- 3 Lights: SunLight, PointLight, SpotLight
- 2 Cameras: MainCamera, OverheadCamera
- 2 Empties: PivotEmpty, TargetEmpty

Organize them as follows:

1. Create a collection named exactly "Geometry" and move ALL mesh objects into it.
2. Create a collection named exactly "Lighting" and move ALL light objects into it.
3. Create a collection named exactly "Cameras" and move ALL camera objects into it.
4. Create a collection named exactly "Helpers" and move ALL empty objects into it.
5. Disable VIEWPORT VISIBILITY (the monitor/screen icon in the outliner) for the "Helpers" collection so empties are hidden during viewport work.
6. Save the file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/organized_scene.blend'.

Do NOT delete any objects. Do NOT rename any objects. Only reorganize them into collections and set the visibility flag.
